The successful candidate will partner with senior engineers, architects, product owners, and data scientists to develop scalable, secure, and resilient solutions leveraging modern AI frameworks, cloud-native technologies, distributed computing platforms, and enterprise engineering practices.
This role is ideal for an engineer passionate about Generative AI, application development, platform engineering, automation, and building reusable capabilities that accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

Develop and enhance enterprise Generative AI platform capabilities, reusable services, and self-service tools.

Design and build AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, RAG solutions, and MCP-enabled services.

Develop scalable APIs, microservices, and platform components supporting AI/ML lifecycle management.

The Opportunity
Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.
We have made a clear strategic choice: Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.
We are looking for a hands-on Technology AI leader who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems - quickly.
This is not a traditional IT leadership role.
You will own the intersection of business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security . You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.
Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.
We need someone who enjoys that challenge.




What You Will Own 1. Technology Execution Delivery
You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.
You will:
Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
Track commitments through completion - not merely development activity.

Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.

evaluating existing architecture,
identifying technical debt,
establishing clear module ownership,

Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
Prototype when speed requires it.
Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.
We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.




8. Security, Reliability AI Governance
You will own the reliability and security of Ergode s technology environment.
Responsibilities include:
Cloud and infrastructure reliability
Monitoring and uptime
Incident management
Root-cause analysis
Backups and disaster recovery
Identity and access management
SSO
Endpoint/device security
Data protection
You will also establish practical AI governance covering:
which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
permissions available to AI agents,
human review requirements for critical decisions,
auditability,
and acceptable AI use.
Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.




9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource
We do not believe everything must be built internally.
We do believe Ergode must own the outcome.
You will decide when to:
BUILD - when capability creates strategic advantage.
BUY - when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.
OUTSOURCE - when an external specialist can deliver faster.
For outsourced work, you will own:
requirements,
architecture,
vendor selection,
commercial evaluation,
milestones,
SLAs,
quality,
security,
source code,
documentation,
handover.
No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.




What Success Looks Like
Within the first 6-12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:
Execution
Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
Delivery predictability improves materially.
Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.
AI Automation
Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
Automation impact is quantified monthly.
Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.
Core Platforms
Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
Technical ownership and documentation improve.
Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.
Data
Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.
Business Partnership
Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect working solutions, not project discussions .




Who We Are Looking For Must-Haves
10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
Practical experience with:
LLM APIs
RAG
AI agents / agentic workflows
Python
workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
API/integration architecture experience.
DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
Experience managing external technology partners.
Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
Strong business and commercial orientation.
Strongly Preferred
Experience in one or more of:
E-commerce
Marketplaces
Retail technology
D2C
SaaS/platform businesses
ERP/OMS/WMS
Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
AI-first enterprise transformation




Who Will NOT Fit This Role
This role is probably not for you if:
Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
You require large teams before you can execute.
You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.




The Person Behind the Resume
We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.
We value people who demonstrate:
Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.
We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer with 56 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience delivering telecom projects and building scalable AI solutions in cloud environments will be highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
Build and orchestrate Agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AWS Strands, or similar technologies.
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases and enterprise knowledge repositories.
Build scalable backend services using FastAPI and Python.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and business workflows.
Deploy and optimize AI applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud environments.
Work with foundation models, embeddings, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration frameworks.
Collaborate with architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready AI solutions.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical design decisions.
Ensure AI solutions follow security, scalability, monitoring, and governance best practices.

Required Skills

5–6 years of experience in AI/ML or Generative AI development.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Solid understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts.
Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Prompt Engineering.
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI.
Strong knowledge of vector databases such as Qdrant, Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, or Weaviate.
Experience with Docker and Git.
Strong debugging, optimization, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills

Hands-on experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience with cloud-native AI services, including:
AWS: Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch
Azure: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Functions
GCP: Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage
Experience deploying AI applications in production cloud environments.
Familiarity with AWS AgentCore for deploying and managing AI agents.
Experience with AWS Strands for building and orchestrating Agentic AI workflows.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and container orchestration.
Understanding of enterprise AI security, governance, and monitoring.

Telecom Experience (Preferred)

Candidates with experience delivering AI solutions for telecom projects will have an advantage, including exposure to:
Customer support automation
AI-powered chatbots and virtual assistants
Network fault detection and root cause analysis
Ticket classification and intelligent routing
Service assurance and telecom operations
Predictive maintenance
AI-driven recommendations and troubleshooting

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, or a related field.
Master's degree is an added advantage.

What We're Looking For

Passion for building enterprise-grade AI solutions.
Strong ownership and accountability in delivering projects.
Ability to work independently and lead technical implementations.
Collaborative mindset with cross-functional teams.
Continuous learning attitude toward emerging AI technologies, cloud platforms, and Agentic AI frameworks.

Background

We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI applications that delivery business value across the organization. This role is focused on building AI applications and services at scale. You will be responsible for building robust, secure, and highly scalable systems that integrate with leading cloud-based AI services.

You will work alongside product managers, designers, and other engineers as an individual contributor. You are expected to own features end-to-end, and to deliver high-quality, reusable code that scales beyond a single use case.

Key Responsibilities

Software Engineering and Execution

Design, build, and ship production-grade Generative and Agentic AI features and applications
Own features end-to-end from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and operation
Build reusable, well-abstracted components and shared utilities (e.g., RAG building blocks, agent scaffolding, evaluation harnesses, prompt utilities) to enable faster delivery of future Generative and Agentic AI products
Build multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK and Google ADK
Integrate with leading LLM and foundation model APIs, including Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search, and re-ranking
Build clean, well-tested RESTful and/or gRPC APIs with a focus on reliability, security, and performance
Implement observability, tracing, evaluation, guardrails for Generative and Agentic AI applications
Deploy and operate services on major cloud providers (e.g., GCP, AWS, and Azure) leveraging managed services
Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, sharing knowledge with peers

Required Qualifications

5-7 years of professional software engineering experience with at least 3 years of experience building AI/ML software products
Bachelors degree in Computer Science or a related field (Master’s degree preferred)
Strong proficiency in Python, with deep software engineering fundamentals (abstraction, modularity, system design, testing, performance)
Hands-on experience building and shipping Generative and Agentic AI applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, and/or agentic workflows
Practical experience integrating cloud-hosted LLM APIs such as Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and/or AWS Bedrock
Experience with agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK) and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Open Search, AlloyDB)
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Azure
Solid understanding of API design, distributed systems, and cloud-native architecture
Track record of taking systems from design through production deployment and operation

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Knowledge of Generative AI Risk Management frameworks (NIST RFM)
Experience supporting developer platforms or internal tooling
